input.command:
cd /tmp/obench-cell-_85_l8l5/bench_opencode_trig-list_9vr37j9j && cat examples/logging.conf && python -m unittest -q 2>&1 | tail -3 && mkdir -p _scratch && python - <<'EOF'
import os
from miniconf.loader import load
from miniconf.errors import ConfigError
c = load("examples/service.conf")
print(c.__dict__)
d = "_scratch"; os.makedirs(d+"/sub", exist_ok=True)
def w(n, t): open(os.path.join(d,n),"w").write(t)
w("a.conf","x = 1\n@include sub/b.conf\ny = 9\n")
w("sub/b.conf","y = 2\nz = 3\n@include c.conf\n")
w("sub/c.conf","w = 4\n")
c = load(d+"/a.conf"); print(c.get("x"), c.get("y"), c.get("z"), c.get("w"))
w("m.conf","@include nope.conf\n")
w("cy1.conf","@include cy2.conf\n"); w("cy2.conf","@include cy1.conf\n")
w("self.conf","@include self.conf\n")
for f in ["m.conf","cy1.conf","self.conf"]:
    try: load(d+"/"+f); print("NO ERROR", f)
    except ConfigError as e: print("ConfigError:", e)
EOF
rm -rf _scratch
